verdicts.reason: A has broken the quote. The 'Albert Einstein' attribution sits between SCIENCE and RELIGION, and the two 'WITHOUT…' lines are swapped and grouped under RELIGION, so the quote now reads wrong. The dark overlay panel has also come loose: it is an empty box on the left, the text is crammed to the right over a busy, bright image, and RELIGION is shrunk below the script attribution. B keeps the original reading order, centred stack and colours, but it reads as the portrait design pillarboxed onto a square. The dark central column has hard vertical edges against brighter, mismatched image strips on the sides, so it is not a true recomposition, and the text block is fairly small in a large canvas.
